continuity_scope: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II, English-language Nintendo Switch base release, 24 February 2023; an eight-protagonist, standalone Solistia continuity.
work_or_witnesses: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II Nintendo Switch base release (Square Enix; 24 February 2023)
Square Enix, 'OCTOPATH TRAVELER II Prologue demo out now' (9 February 2023)

work_or_witnesses.work: Square Enix Europe store, OCTOPATH TRAVELER II product page
work_or_witnesses.edition: Official product story and feature metadata for the base release.

work_or_witnesses: Square Enix, cross-platform/Extra Battle announcement (6 June 2024)
coverage_rule: All eight named player protagonists expressly identified in the official English pre-release profile are included. The four named Crossed Paths pairings expressly published by Nintendo are included as light-spoiler character-to-character links. No unprofiled NPC, boss, monster, party recruit, job holder, faction, region, or optional/player-variable narrative endpoint is inferred.
omissions: The 2018 OCTOPATH TRAVELER, OCTOPATH TRAVELER: Champions of the Continent mobile title, and other numbered or later franchise works are separate continuity units.
Post-2023 ports, the 6 June 2024 Extra Battle update, a future Switch 2 edition, bundles, Collector's Edition goods, and localization-specific text are not treated as base-release narrative evidence.

Named antagonists, supporting NPCs, optional recruits, bosses, and endgame outcomes are omitted because the selected official witness set does not furnish a reproducible complete character roster for them.
Jobs/classes, Path Actions, guilds, monsters, regions, day/night states, combat systems, items, and the player-selected primary protagonist/party are recorded only as terms where evidenced.
uncertainties: Square Enix's eight-protagonist profiles are promotional/prologue material and establish premises, not exhaustive biographies or final outcomes.
The official demo article remains indexed at an amp URL; its claims are cross-checked against Square Enix and Nintendo first-party pages, but no physical cartridge/build was inspected.
Crossed Paths establish presented protagonist pair stories, not a universal party order, romance, final outcome, or an exhaustive account of all interpersonal relationships.
English names and role labels are bound to the English localization; this pass makes no claims about wording in other localizations.
evidence_basis: Square Enix and Nintendo first-party product, demo, release, and update pages. Scope deliberately preserves the anthology/player-choice boundary and excludes unsupported narrative detail.
